# Autarki

> The buyer pays you, and you keep the keys. Autarki is the wallet and the shop.

Autarki is in beta. It runs on your computer. A 64-bit Android phone can install its own copy. A phone on the same network can still open your computer's page. This website stores nothing and does not take an order. Pay with XBT or Pay with BTC. XBT is named first.

## Pages

- [Home](https://autarki.app/index.md): No platform. Just the sale. The buyer pays you, and you keep the keys.
- [Notice board](https://autarki.app/notice-board.md): A wallet publishes the stall. This page reads the relay, stores nothing, and does not take an order. A description that starts with Available only on Autarki; is left off.
- [Wallet](https://autarki.app/wallet.md): You hold the 24 words. On a package that starts Lightning, paying the other coin spends the coin this wallet already holds. The fee is 1.5%, plus the normal network fees.
- [Shop](https://autarki.app/shop.md): The shop runs on your computer. The stall is public. The order is private. Autarki does not take a cut of the catalog price. One product can keep a US dollar or Canadian dollar price. The dollar price stays and the coin amount is set when you pay. Lightning has a routing fee and a room fee.
- [Classifieds](https://autarki.app/classifieds.md): Ship pays with Lightning. With a float, the coins sit on the seller's node until Mark received. The named referee decides and does not hold the coins. This page can publish a note a Nostr extension signs. The form has the same place, image, and map fields as the app. Category comes first. Offer and Hire appear only for a job. A hire carries no payment code. One ad can keep a price in US dollars or Canadian dollars. The dollar price stays and the coin amount is set when you pay. Goods, a service, or a rental with a price above zero names the shipment. A giveaway can name images. A personal does not. Preview this ad shows the note on this page and does not publish it. Show this ad on other markets posts a second note with no price. The sale stays on the relay this board reads. The board terms are accepted before the first note.
- [Mining](https://autarki.app/mining.md): Paste a RouteHash token, then click Mine XBT or Mine BTC. The next reward address is your wallet's. Nothing is spent until Mine.
- [Install](https://autarki.app/install.md): Lightning for XBT and for BTC is in the AMD and Intel StartOS package, the Ubuntu image, the Umbrel amd64 image file, and Android 0.1.0 (29). The Umbrel community store listing 0.1.24, a Raspberry Pi, and Umbrel arm64 leave Lightning off. iPhone 0.1.0 build 8 does not start Lightning.
- [Privacy](https://autarki.app/privacy.md): The 24 words stay on your device. The camera scans a code. Location fills the shop. The page talks to relays and nodes. Save a copy of the shop book before you wipe the app. The 24 words do not bring that book back. The wallet's classifieds list starts at wss://165.245.235.36:51911. This site still reads and publishes classifieds at wss://nostr.autarki.app.
- [Board rules](https://autarki.app/board.md): Rules for a public shop note and a classified. Child sexual content is forbidden. A report does not remove the ad.
- [Support](https://autarki.app/support.md): Help with Autarki is in Discord #autarki. This site does not sign in and cannot recover the 24 words.
- [Another node](https://autarki.app/channel.md): Incoming room for a Lightning node that is not the Autarki page in front of you. Blake2b XBT, then SHA-256 BTC. The price is sats. This page does not take the fee. A bare fee does not name the node.

## Optional

- [Download 0.1.0](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki/releases/tag/0.1.0): The public download. Check SHA256SUMS from that same release.
- [Android 0.1.0](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki/releases/download/0.1.0/autarki-android.apk): Version 0.1.0 (29). Lightning for Blake2b XBT bitcoin and SHA-256 BTC bitcoin is in this package. Download for a 64-bit Android phone. Allow the phone to install it. This file installs over the previous signed 0.1.0 package. A phone that already has 0.1.0 (1) has to uninstall that copy first. There is no Play Store listing to announce. Request access at https://appdistribution.firebase.dev/i/2ae8a6c81ce866a4.
- [iPhone 0.1.0](https://testflight.apple.com/join/2WMBzSpM): Version 0.1.0, build 8. This build does not start Lightning. It is not an App Store listing. Join the public TestFlight test.
- [Source](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/autarki): The Autarki repository.
- [Umbrel community store](https://github.com/RouteHash-com/umbrel-store): The RouteHash community store. It is not the official Umbrel App Store.
- [Discord #autarki](https://discord.gg/VBxvzQXvt): Bug reports.
- [routehash.com](https://routehash.com): The mining site. The hire happens in the wallet.
